newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains ease on profit taking, find support.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains ease on profit taking, find support.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures eased Friday amid end of week profit-taking, traders said.
But futures found good buying support to prevent the fall going any further. "It's still underpinned," one trader said.
"Sterling permitting, I would expect it to steady next week," he said.
The strength of sterling had played a part in Friday's fall, he said.
Friday's easing comes as a correction after the enthusiasm of rises, especially on Wednesday, when talk of a shipment to China sent futures up.
Active March wheat last traded 0.50 stg down at 98.70 stg. March volume was 230 of a total 416 lots of wheat traded.
On Barley, only November traded with 15 lots changing hands. It ended 0.25 lower at 92.75 stg.
